import dask
import dask.dataframe as dd
from dask.backends import detect_entrypoints
entries = detect_entrypoints("dask.dataframe.backends")

assert isinstance(entries, dict)
data = {"a": [1, 2, 3, 4], "B": [10, 11, 12, 13]}
with dask.config.set({"dataframe.backend": "pandas"}):

        dd.from_dict(data, npartitions=2, unsupported_kwarg=True)
    except TypeError as error:
        message = str(error)
        print("backend_error:", message)
        assert "error occurred while calling the from_dict method" in message
        assert "pandas" in message
    else:
        raise AssertionError("Unsupported argument unexpectedly accepted")
